name: House on posts (our own design)
about: Made by tools/battle-models/asia (scenery). Metres; x east, y right, z up from the ground at its foot. Stands still: `sway` (0 to 1, point by point) is how far the wind moves each point; nothing else moves. Looks only: the battle's ground decides cover and passage. Paints: 0 wood, 1 wood_dark, 2 weave, 3 thatch, 4 thatch_old, 5 thatch_under, 6 opening, 7 bamboo
